about: Wall seconds per venture test suite, from run_venture_tests.py --write-times. Times taken with `jobs` suites in parallel on `cpus` cores, so they are relative, not a single-suite benchmark. `seconds` maps slug to wall seconds, slowest first; `failed` lists suites that failed in that run. Read it with `run_venture_tests.py --times N`; time one suite's files alone with `suite_file_times.py <slug>`.
